findings.name: notifications_original
findings.query: select "id", "player_id", "kind", "payload", "seen", "created_at", "ref_id" from "notifications" where "notifications"."player_id" = $1 order by "notifications"."created_at" desc limit $2

findings.name: notifications_two_index_branches
findings.query: select * from ((select "id", "player_id", "kind", "payload", "seen", "created_at", "ref_id" from "notifications" where "notifications"."player_id" = $1 and "notifications"."seen" = false order by "notifications"."created_at" desc limit $2) union all (select "id", "player_id", "kind", "payload", "seen", "created_at", "ref_id" from "notifications" where "notifications"."player_id" = $1 and "notifications"."seen" = true order by "notifications"."created_at" desc limit $2)) latest order by created_at desc limit $2

findings.name: notifications_new_time_index
findings.query: select "id", "player_id", "kind", "payload", "seen", "created_at", "ref_id" from "notifications" where "notifications"."player_id" = $1 order by "notifications"."created_at" desc limit $2

findings.name: research_original
findings.query:
select "id" from "battle_reports" where ("battle_reports"."attacker_player_id" = $1 and "battle_reports"."shield_absorbed" > $2 and (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM((round ->> 'attackerDamage')::double precision), 0)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements("battle_reports"."rounds") AS round
  ) > 0 and "battle_reports"."shield_absorbed" >= (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM((round ->> 'attackerDamage')::double precision), 0)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements("battle_reports"."rounds") AS round
  )
            * $3) limit $4

findings.name: research_single_json_aggregate
findings.query:
with candidate as materialized (
    select id,shield_absorbed,(select coalesce(sum((r ->> 'attackerDamage')::double precision),0)
      from jsonb_array_elements(rounds) r) damage
    from battle_reports where attacker_player_id=$1 and shield_absorbed>$2
  ) select id from candidate where damage>0 and shield_absorbed>=damage*$3 limit $4
